]

# Function to calculate correlation
def correlation(x, y):
    n = len(x)
    mean_x = sum(x) / n
    mean_y = sum(y) / n
    
    numerator = sum((x[i] - mean_x) * (y[i] - mean_y) for i in range(n))
    denominator_x = math.sqrt(sum((x[i] - mean_x)**2 for i in range(n)))
    denominator_y = math.sqrt(sum((y[i] - mean_y)**2 for i in range(n)))
    
    return numerator / (denominator_x * denominator_y)

    2.46, 2.47, 2.48, 2.37, 2.19, 2.25, 2.44, 2.31, 2.32, 2.57,
    2.68, 2.94, 2.55, 2.84, 3.08, 3.47, 3.43, 4.08, 4.02, 3.90,
    3.95, 4.00, 4.15, 4.21, 4.65
]

moody_yields = [
    2.83, 2.73, 2.72, 2.62, 2.53, 2.61, 2.82, 2.66, 2.62, 2.86,
    2.96, 3.20, 2.90, 3.06, 3.36, 3.89, 3.79, 4.38, 4.41, 4.35,
    4.33, 4.26, 4.40, 4.49, 5.13
]

# Function to calculate correlation
def correlation(x, y):
    n = len(x)
    mean_x = sum(x) / n
    mean_y = sum(y) / n
    
    numerator = sum((x[i] - mean_x) * (y[i] - mean_y) for i in range(n))
    denominator_x = math.sqrt(sum((x[i] - mean_x)**2 for i in range(n)))
    denominator_y = math.sqrt(sum((y[i] - mean_y)**2 for i in range(n)))
    
    return numerator / (denominator_x * denominator_y)
